text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Brunswick Avenue, between Dupont Street and Wells Street. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the traffic calming policy needed to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of Brunswick Avenue. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Brunswick Avenue, between Dupont Street and Wells Street, is not recommended.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The City Solicitor prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install five speed humps on Brunswick Avenue, between Dupont Street and Wells Street, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-3080, dated June 2018 attached to the report entitled "Speed Hump Poll Results - Brunswick Avenue" from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
